sourceTaskPrompt: A plugin can register multiple implementations of the same hook using `specname`. Unregistering that plugin currently removes only one implementation, and `get_hookcallers(plugin)` can return the same HookCaller more than once. Make unregister remove every implementation owned by the plugin while preserving implementation ordering for other plugins, and make `get_hookcallers` return each affected HookCaller exactly once. Add focused regressions covering multiple implementations on one hook and a plugin spanning more than one hook.
